name: auto_mpg
title: Auto MPG
citation: Quinlan, R. (1993). Auto MPG [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
limits: Cars from 1970 to 1982 only. Six rows without horsepower were removed upstream.
verified: license and DOI read from the UCI dataset page on 2026-11-17

name: breast_cancer
title: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
citation: Wolberg, W. et al. (1993). Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic). UCI Machine Learning Repository.
limits: Single institution, small sample, features computed from digitised fine needle aspirate images.

name: wine
title: Wine recognition
citation: Aeberhard, S. and Forina, M. (1992). Wine. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
limits: Three cultivars from one Italian region, very small sample.

name: digits
title: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits
access: bundled in scikit-learn (load_digits, test split of the UCI data)
citation: Alpaydin, E. and Kaynak, C. (1998). Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

name: mnist_5000
title: MNIST subset (5000 images)
source: MNIST by LeCun, Cortes and Burges
license: CC BY-SA 3.0 as stated on the Hugging Face dataset card for MNIST (verify before reuse)
citation: LeCun, Y., Cortes, C. and Burges, C. MNIST handwritten digit database.
limits: Subset chosen by the mlxtend authors, 28x28 grey images.

name: diabetes
title: Diabetes disease progression
source: Efron, Hastie, Johnstone, Tibshirani (2004), Least Angle Regression
license: distributed with scikit-learn (BSD-3-Clause package); original data terms not stated
citation: Efron, B., Hastie, T., Johnstone, I., Tibshirani, R. (2004). Least angle regression. Annals of Statistics 32(2).
limits: Features are mean centred and scaled by the provider. Only 442 patients.
verified: citation verified through Crossref; data terms not stated by provider

name: telco_churn
title: Telco customer churn
access: downloaded on first use by ml_lab.data.load_dataset
license: repository is Apache-2.0, dataset terms are not stated (verify before redistribution)
citation: IBM. Telco customer churn sample data set, IBM/telco-customer-churn-on-icp4d, GitHub.
limits: One snapshot with no time dimension. The publisher does not document how the data was collected.
verified: repository license read on GitHub 2026-11-17, dataset terms unstated
